questions.sec: Initial Investigations, Common Lymphoid Progenitor Markers, Precursor B-Cell Maturation & CLL Origin

questions.sec: Initial Investigations, Common Lymphoid Progenitor Markers, Precursor B-Cell Maturation & CLL Origin

Complete rearrangement of heavy & light chain; expresses S.IgM with CD 19, CD 20, CD 21, CD 22, CD79a, CD 79b; loses CD 10 and TdT; bad prognosis

questions.sec: Initial Investigations, Common Lymphoid Progenitor Markers, Precursor B-Cell Maturation & CLL Origin

questions.q: When evaluating an enlarged cervical lymph node suspected of B-cell lymphoma using the diagnostic principles on pages 140–141, how does immunophenotyping distinguish Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) from Marginal Zone Lymphoma (MZL) when both express pan-B markers (CD 19, CD 20, CD 21, CD 22, CD 79a, CD 79b, S.IgM) and lack CD 10?

units.title: Initial Investigations, Common Lymphoid Progenitor Markers, Precursor B-Cell Maturation & CLL Origin
units.sec: Initial Investigations, Common Lymphoid Progenitor Markers, Precursor B-Cell Maturation & CLL Origin
units.guide:
Investigations: FNAC, trucut/excision biopsy shows loss of lymph node architecture; immunophenotyping is diagnostic. Common lymphoid progenitor → B cell (CD 19), T cell (CD 3), NK cell (CD 56).
Precursor B-cell stages (Precursor B-cell ALL; m/c = Pre-B ALL): Pro-B = incomplete heavy chain, CD 19 + CD 34/HLA-DR/PAX-5 (bad prognosis); Pre-B = complete heavy chain, CD 10 (CALLA), TdT, CD 20/21/22/79a/79b + CD 19, loses CD 34/HLA-DR (good prognosis); Immature-B = complete heavy & light chain, S.IgM, loses CD 10/TdT (bad prognosis).
Naive B cell (no antigen encounter; CD 19/20/21/22/79a/79b, S.IgM): failure of apoptosis → clonal proliferation → CLL (acquires CD 5, CD 23).

units.title: Lymph Node Zones (Pre-Germinal, Germinal Centre, Post-Germinal/Marginal Zone), Myeloma Markers & CD Summary
units.sec: Lymph Node Zones (Pre-Germinal, Germinal Centre, Post-Germinal/Marginal Zone), Myeloma Markers & CD Summary
units.guide:
LN zones: 1. Pre-germinal centre/mantle layer (after Naive B cell gains S.IgD in interfollicular area) → Mantle cell lymphoma (CD 5, Cyclin D); 2. Germinal centre (CD 10, CD 23, BCL-6): Centroblast (dark zone) → DLBCL, Burkitt's; somatic hypermutation & affinity maturation → Centrocyte (light zone) → Follicular lymphoma, Plasma blast, or Marginal zone.
Plasma blast proliferation → ABC-DLBCL; Plasma cell → Multiple myeloma (CD 38, CD 138, C19 [printed]; loses all other markers). Post-germinal/marginal zone → Marginal zone lymphoma; Memory B cell → Hairy cell leukemia, SLL, Waldenstrom's macroglobulinemia.
Summary panel: CD5+ CD10– CD23+ = CLL; CD5+ CD10– CD23– = MCL; CD5– CD10+ CD23+ = GC; CD5– CD10– CD23– = MZL.
